posts.hook: A US state just asked a judge to hit the brakes on OpenAI
posts.caption: florida wants a court to halt openai's frontier development, anthropic shipped sonnet 5.5 with a cheaper price per task claim, and amd is buying world labs for about $8.2b. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
